ammonia.reason: Deamination during proteolysis with pH rise 4.87 to ~5.7 and pH4.6-SN ~48% releases NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Low 4-methyloctanoic 0.3 ppm plus trace p-cresol in cow milk; less barnyard than sheep Roquefort.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic bitter peptides from chymosin and P. roqueforti proteinases accentuated by 3% NaCl S/M 7.1.

blue_moldy.reason: P. roqueforti PR-R beta-oxidation of fatty acids to 2-heptanone/2-nonanone plus secondary alcohols in needled veins.

browning.reason: Maillard between proteolysis-derived amino acids and trace lactose plus fat browning on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by mesophilic Lactococcus plus C4 ketones softened by mold.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Very high butanoic 321-5070 mg/kg plus hexanoic 214-2518 mg/kg plus 3-methylbutanoic from lipase and leucine catabolism.

creaminess.reason: FDM ~52% fat 30% plus lipolysis and mold-softened matrix give creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Pierced blue veins and dry-salted curd create short friable fracture despite creamy matrix.

firmness.reason: Moisture ~44% MNFS ~60-67% plus mold proteolysis softens rennet gel to semi-soft cuttable body.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism, suppressed by dominant ketones.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol by mold esterases.

goaty.reason: Octanoic 118 ppm plus decanoic ~258 ppm waxy-goaty from lipolysis; no 4-ethyloctanoic in cow milk limits intensity.

malty_nutty.reason: Low Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine; masked by ketones, no propionibacteria.

melt.reason: pH 5.3 demineralized para-casein with 30% fat flows readily; not acid-set non-melter.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from linoleic acid oxidation via Penicillium lipoxygenase.

oil_off.reason: High free fat and lipolyzed triglycerides coalesce to free oil when heated.

smoky.reason: No smoking, no wood phenols/guaiacol; unsmoked pasteurized blue.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic 1073 mg/kg from heterofermentation/lactate oxidation plus lactic acid at pH ~5.3.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata stretching; highly proteolyzed rennet curd lacks intact para-kappa-casein network.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methionine catabolism to dimethyl sulfide/disulfide by starter/mold; pasteurized 74C 15s, curd not cooked.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose depleted, salt and acids suppress sweet; little lactone perception.

umami.reason: Extensive proteolysis to glutamate/aspartate peptides by rennet and P. roqueforti proteinases.
